title: M1 exit-test harness: 10 fresh scans to reachable summit + two routes
summary: The measurement behind the M1 milestone exit test: run 10 fresh room scans (not in the training corpus) end to end and report, per scan, whether a reachable summit and at least two validator-approved routes were produced with no manual fixes. The Owner judges the milestone at the checkpoint; this harness supplies the evidence.

acceptance_tests.test: qa/scripts run 10 fresh scans through the full pipeline and produce qa/reports/M1-exit.md with a per-scan pass/fail on 'reachable summit + two valid routes, no manual fixes'.
Each pass links its environment_spec.json and the validator output; failures link the input and the failure reason.
The result (target: 8 of 10) is summarized for the Owner's milestone judgment; under 6 of 10 triggers the re-plan AUTH per the kit.
